scope: Multi-domain academic concept and relation extraction

document_prescreening.rationale: Prevents combinatorial explosion and dense false cycles caused by back-of-book indices and author lists.

concept_extraction.boundary_cleaning: Unicode NFC normalization, whitespace collapse, punctuation stripping

relation_extraction.abstention_policy: Strict abstention when arguments cross clause boundaries or lack explicit relational verb triggers.

graph_integrity_and_cycles.prerequisite_cycle_prevention: Full reachability DFS on REQUIRES and INFERRED_REQUIRES edges
graph_integrity_and_cycles.heterogeneous_cycle_policy: Permits reciprocal symmetric relations on CONTRASTS_WITH and RELATED; allows semantic cycles across heterogeneous edges (e.g., A USES B, B CONTRASTS_WITH A).
graph_integrity_and_cycles.dag_guarantee: Strict DAG on prerequisite relation subgraphs.
